job.title: Lead Backend Engineer E-Commerce [m/w/d] - Hamburg / Berlin

tailoring.headline: Lead Backend & E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud & Java Spring
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, database performance tuning, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer holding a valid German residence and work permit, currently serving notice.

cover_en.subject: Application: Lead Backend Engineer E-Commerce [m/w/d] - Hamburg / Berlin
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Lead Backend Engineer E-Commerce position at Die Tech Recruiter GmbH. With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in backend architectures, API development, and agile team leadership.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Backend Leadership
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: CI/CD & DevOps Execution
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, supported by strong SQL and performance tuning skills.

bullets.label: Team Mentorship
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production issues, and provided technical guidance to junior developers while collaborating in international agile teams.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise is rooted in Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud rather than PHP, Symfony, and Laravel, I am keen to leverage my strong backend engineering foundations to learn and adapt quickly to your stack.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your team.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work for Die Tech Recruiter GmbH because of your focus on cutting-edge e-commerce technology and innovative projects. My 5+ years of backend experience scaling enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell match your need for engineering leadership and robust backend solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce backend experience, CI/CD execution skills, and technical mentoring background to lead and support your engineering team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am interested in the Lead Backend Engineer E-Commerce role at Die Tech Recruiter GmbH. With 5+ years of backend e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java/Spring and CI/CD execution skills. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Lead Backend Engineer E-Commerce - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Lead Backend Engineer E-Commerce position at Die Tech Recruiter GmbH. With over 5 years of backend e-commerce experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in backend development, database optimization, CI/CD execution, and technical mentoring.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am available to start from 16 December 2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
